instant.$description: Keyboard selection, high-frequency navigation, scrolling and decorative movement under reduced motion stay immediate.

feedback.$description: Optional low-frequency visual feedback. Frequent hover/highlight tracking remains instant.

press.$description: Subtle press response where movement helps acknowledge an action.

enter.$description: A small element entering, anchored to its trigger when applicable.

exit.$description: A shorter exit: the user has already decided to dismiss the element.

move.$description: A deliberate pointer-driven relocation within the screen; use translation without scaling text or borders.

reduced.$description: Optional opacity-only replacement when it conveys meaning. Pure decoration is removed entirely.

enter-large.$description: Large-area entrances, such as broad drawers, dialogs and inspector panels. Allow the eye to follow the surface while the ease-out keeps the response immediate.

exit-large.$description: Large-area dismissals. Slightly shorter than entry, but long enough to avoid an abrupt disappearance of a broad surface.

move-large.$description: Deliberate repositioning of large on-screen surfaces. Use when visual area or travel makes the small movement timing feel jarring; not native scrolling or keyboard navigation.

reflow.$description: Quick repositioning of surviving items after removal; keep text and borders at their original scale.

reflow-rapid.$description: Short visible settling when repeated pointer actions remove collection items. Continue from the current pose without replaying an anticipation hold or queuing movement.

feedback.$description: Small changes in color, background or opacity.

press.$description: Responsive subtle press feedback with no overshoot.

enter.$description: A fast start and soft settle for entrances.

exit.$description: The same curve family as entry, paired with a shorter duration.

move.$description: Accelerate then decelerate during on-screen movement.

enter-large.$description: Same entry/exit curve family as the small transition; duration accounts for the greater visual area. No overshoot.

exit-large.$description: Same entry/exit curve family as the small transition; duration accounts for the greater visual area. No overshoot.

move-large.$description: Same on-screen movement curve family as the small transition; duration accounts for the greater visual area. No overshoot.

reflow.$description: Accelerate and settle as surrounding items fill a removed item’s space.

reflow-rapid.$description: A restrained ease-out makes the short removal path readable while keeping repeated actions responsive.
